method: Reviewed the complete hardening lesson and its current skeleton dependency. Clarified that fourteen checklist topics produce sixteen printed records because the policy/scope topic expands into three automated predicates. Ran the W6 scope verifier and preserved issue-scoped verifier; the latter extracts the lesson Python fence and executes it against the complete current skeleton in a temporary directory. observations.trace: The checklist has fourteen table topics. The executable output contains nine automated predicates, five manual records and two skip records (sixteen output rows); three predicates cover the single policy/default-deny/scope topic. The preserved verifier passes 9/9, including execution of all six smoke cases, budget stop, idempotency, trace locators and expected approval/version gaps. Production build generated 404 pages and Pagefind indexed 404 pages / 15,462 words. Light/dark full-page captures are 1300x8115 with 792px article width, viewport/document scroll width 1300px and Mermaid rendered; one browser error was the existing favicon 404.

limitations: This is a local deterministic code and documentation check; it does not establish production authorization, cross-user/global quotas, real model tool-result provenance, deployment/versioning, or log storage and retention.
The six fixed smoke cases are not a representative evaluation set or a production release gate.
No new provider call, external service, production deployment, or visual rebuild was performed in this pass.
